cases.question: A lender proposes to include a covenant in the loan agreement requiring the Borrower to maintain its deposit accounts with the lender, with the interest rate on the loan increasing by 1.00% if the Borrower fails to do so. Under SBA Loan Program Requirements, is such a provision permissible, or would the rate increase constitute a prohibited Preference (as a compensating balance arrangement) or an impermissible default rate?
